## Change

Describe the problem and resulting behavior or documentation change. Link the
issue; use a closing keyword only when its acceptance criteria are satisfied.

## Verification and review

List checks actually run and results. Identify the reviewed head and independent
or automatic review evidence. State when no runtime, UI check, or CI applies.

## Remaining limits

Record meaningful follow-up work, pending decisions, or blockers. Update the
linked issues, project status, and affected docs; omit this section if unnecessary.
